extracted.intended_audience: general readers and students of early-modern European history
extracted.subtask_short: historical narrative of Thirty Years' War
extracted.subtask_description: A prose historical account narrating political and military events, characters, and campaigns of the Thirty Years' War (early 17th century), emphasizing leaders, tactics, and diplomatic maneuvering. Aimed at informing and interpreting events rather than prescribing procedures or evaluation criteria.
